extracted.name: Cranberry Margarita
extracted.description: This cranberry margarita recipe is the perfect festive holiday cocktail! It's sweet, tart, refreshing, and delicious.
ingredient_lines: Lime wedge (for the glass rim, optional)
Coarse salt (for the glass rim, optional)
1 ounce orange liqueur (such as Cointreau or triple sec)
instruction_lines: Salt the rim of the glass (optional): Rub a lime wedge around the rim of a rocks glass. Fill a small plate with coarse salt. Dip the glass into the salt to coat the rim. Fill with ice.
Place the cranberry juice, tequila, orange liqueur, and lime juice in a cocktail shaker with ice. Shake and strain into the glass. Garnish with cranberries and rosemary and serve.
